subject: harley-calder
label: Harley bottoms
from: A natural top until rope appears — a recording error
note: A CORRECTION, dated to her arrival because it was never otherwise true. The v5 profile hedged her as a top who converts under rope, and the Dual-Domme / Sub Reversal label in the old appendix hedged the pairing the same way. Both are RETIRED. Yvaine tops; Harley bottoms, brats her way toward it, and melts the instant the rope comes out. Her own recorded line — tie me, or I'll haunt your bed forever, said already kneeling — rather settles it.
